name: 林志哲

Week 6 Sensors

Week 8 Stepper Motors
Week 9 Alternating current motors
Week 10 Midterm test
Week 11 Actuators: Electric, Hydraulic, and Pneumatic
Week 12 Relay and PLC
Week 13 Relay and PLC
Week 14 Relay and PLC
Week 15 feedback control principles
Week 16  feedback control principles
Week 17 final test & 各組針對自選自動化系統實作之報告, 全班參與。
